message: Root implementation feedback (not independent review): current AzureExecutor.body serializes properties.template as data[1].decode('utf-8'), a JSON string. Official 2025-04-01 DeploymentProperties.template is type object; actual ARM expects a template object, so immediate mock acceptance would hide an invalid API request. Keep approved original bytes hash-bound, embed their parsed object for native JSON envelope, and add an actual payload-shape assertion to deterministic transport. Also final submit callback performs owner/graph scans and durable audit after WriteBoundary's deadline check; ensure credential/policy/preview expiry cannot cross during these operations then still send a mutation. Prior T003 expiry regression is relevant: recheck the bounded admission deadline immediately before transport send after all local work, with an injected advancing-clock failure case. These are concrete review observations on current code; do not invent a quality verdict.
